quest.title: On the Darkbrood Trail
quest.description: You had, it appeared, uncovered a lot of answers here. Now you only needed to figure out what the questions were! There was something dark here, some underlying motivation that floated just below the facts like a silent ocean beast...floating, biding it's time.

node.journal_entry: With the adorably typical Orkish lack of any flair or ceremony, the Emissary intoned several grating syllables over the now hissing brazier and looked at you expectantly.

The second fiend you slew fell much as the first. The odd, echoing voice gurgling to a stop. This time, however, you noticed that much of his gear was damaged by ice and frost. You recalled that many of the other Darkbrood also sported similar signs of having travelled through icy conditions recently.

task.task_instruction: Slay ranking Darkbrood and search them for clues.

node.journal_entry: Even before you touched the strange, hand shaped altar before you, I think you knew something was amiss. Then, suddenly, your mind was reeling, assaulted by images and sounds darker than anything you had experienced!

node.instruction: Enter the Portal that leads to the Dungeon of the Doombringer.

node.journal_entry: This was some sort of link to the hive mind you had experienced before, but also there was something more, something sinister and hidden behind the maddened whisperings of a thousand voices.

The emissary stood out like an angry, sore thumb in the middle of the city with a large smoking brazier. Not one to mince words, the brooding Ork grunted when you asked if you could communicate with the Shaman. You'd need ten burning bile sacs from Salamander to get the ritual going.

node.instruction: Bring the information you discovered back to someone who might know more.

node.journal_entry: I have always loved the simple charm of the Ork-folk. When you held out the sack of sacs, as it were, the Emissary said, "well? what do I look like, your freakin' nursemaid? Put the blood in the brazier you maggot!"
You had several avenues before you now, several options to glean some semblance of guidance...and time was ticking!
Ever favoring the direct approach, you returned straight to the Shaman himself. He listened eagerly to your tale and agreed that the Darkbrood seemed to be the ultimate culprits behind the Fetish.

action.tag: A Start Client SFX on Specific Object Action
A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action

node.instruction: You need 10 Bile Sacks in your backpack
Cast the 10 bile sacks in the brazzier.

node.journal_entry: The manner of combat these Darkbrood used was more than a little odd. For such stocky, unwieldy frames, they moved in perfect, fluid unison. They struck together in perfect rhythm, almost as if with one thought.

He did not, however, seem perturbed about the yet lack of any clear understanding behind their motives. Almost dismissively, he pointed out that such things oft came to light in their own time. The important thing now was that there was someone clearly in need of punishing!
All that remained now, was the surely simple task of locating who that might be! It was, in the Ork's own words, time to crack some skulls to crack some clues!

This forge, tinged with darkness, you had seen before. Clearly of Darkbrood construction, it sported a number of templates for weapons that were clearly designed to cause maximum pain. There was little about this forge that spoke of craftsmanship.. only of a need to hurt.
The fiend fell before you, his odd, echoing voice gurgling one last death rattle as his eyes focused on you, an odd stare of blank, homicidal rage even in death.

task.task_instruction: Slay ranking Darkbrood and search them for clues.

node.instruction: Return to an Emissary or to the Orkish Shaman.
node.journal_entry: You returned to the Emissary with your findings. After a brief and smoky conversation with the Shaman it was determined that the Doom beneath the Ice must refer to a being known as the Doombringer.

Now here was the grandmother of all clues! This portal veritably screamed Darkbrood architecture. And the steady stream of heavy boot prints that came and went meant that somewhere deep within, the leader of the Darkbrood had very likely made his (very well guarded) lair!

node.instruction: Enter the Portal that leads to the Dungeon of the Doombringer.

action.tag: An Add Quest Area to World-Map Action

node.journal_entry: Returning to $[Vendors.q09_quest_acolyte_librarian_Name] was probably the first and most prudent step. Lugging his books about while you tracked sinister plots and insidious evils was probably not something you felt like doing either.

The gentle purple haze of the Athenaeum welcomed you back to the bastion of books. $[Vendors.q09_quest_acolyte_librarian_Name] was ecstatic and after a long and slightly awkward reunion with his books (I've never seen a man kiss a tome before...not with such passion!) he listened with growing interest to your tale.

The beings you saw, he postulated, were indeed known as the Darkbrood. The legends he remembered told of an ancient god who corrupted Dwarven blood and souls to create an army of puppets. Something went awry however and his own will became so saturated that his consciousness merged with that of his thralls, forming a hive-mind that existed in a perpetual state of homicidal insanity, suffused with the whispered shrieks of an ever-dying god.

Behrem suggested you return to the Shaman with this new insight. He made a point of reminding you that there was an Orkish emissary in every capital city that could direct your communications to the capital via a simple ritual of flame.

The Shaman then grinned and pounded you on the chest. YOU, he declared, were now deputized by the Iron Fist! It would be your grand honor to act as the mighty Orkish hammer of justice and cave in the skull of whoever led the Darkbrood!
The Emissary did not seem further inclined to help you beyond that...
It took you a moment to realize that the smoky reflection of the Shaman was also peering at you from the air above the brazier!

Nevertheless, once the awkward and universally accepted rituals of long distance communication had been settled, ("hello, I can hear you, can you hear me? How about now?") you informed the Shaman of all that you had discovered.
He listened eagerly to your tale and agreed that the Darkbrood seemed to be the ultimate culprits behind the Fetish.

He did not, however, seem perturbed about the yet lack of any clear understanding behind their motives. Almost dismissively, he pointed out that such things oft came to light in their own time. The important thing now was that there was someone clearly in need of punishing!

The Shaman then grinned and pounded you on the chest. YOU, he declared, were now deputized by the Iron Fist! It would be your grand honor to act as the mighty Orkish hammer of justice and cave in the skull of whoever led the Darkbrood!
You did manage to make out one word from within the maelstrom of insanity...Doombringer!
Suddenly, as you stood before the portal, a booming voice intoned within your mind!

"There! That is the entrance to the lair of the villain maggot! By order of the Flaming Path, you are authorized to enter this domain and slay the one known as the Doombringer! For his crimes against mortality, the Doombringer is sentenced to inevitability..."
Whilst his presence had been often talked about by those that travelled the icy continent of Nifflheim, none had seen him and lived to report on his situation.
With some glee and delight, the Shaman informed you that it would be your happy task to be the first to meet this Doombringer, and slay him for his crimes.
That certainly did not bode well...
Even more clear, I assume it was to you then, that he would be making a featured cameo in your immediate, and more than likely, painful future!
The aforementioned skulls and clues would likely be found around Darkbrood camps and outposts of course.

Then, something caught your eye. Many of the templates and even the forge itself bore a subtly hidden rune about them. The rune, you would later discover, in the ancient Dwarvish tongue, meant, "The Doom beneath the Ice."

node.instruction: Return to an Emissary or to the Orkish Shaman.
node.journal_entry: You returned to the Emissary with your findings. The word Doombringer seemed to cause quite a bit of smoky chatter between him and the Shaman. It was clear, they determined, that this being was leading the Darkbrood. It was just as clear, therefore, that he must be held ultimately accountable for their actions!

node.journal_entry: The Shaman seemed surprised to see you. This, I felt, was quite understandable given that he had previously told you that you could communicate with him directly via one of the Emissaries in any capital city. Still, I am sure you had your reasons for going all the way back to speak to him directly...perhaps you liked the twinkle in his eye?
Nevertheless, the clues you had uncovered seemed to bring one particular word to light and it did not seem to make the Shaman happy.

The Doombringer. It seemed you now had a target! The Shaman informed you that the name had surfaced from time to time of late, mostly via tales of terror told about the Ice Continent. It was said that this Doombringer lurked beneath the icy waste of Svartvann and now, they knew why.
The Doombringer was clearly the leader of the Darkbrood and directed their activity from the bowels of the frosted realm. It was, therefore, your happy task to put an end to this!
